subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of the question mark (?) will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/de191d1f366b8b5a31298d3c3597571b09193294fd81055486b00751a12baf6d.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The lower triangle rotates 180º.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b861f2b37629b5d5b85cf23c62487e8e631088c1f71b9f0ede47d986be672e1.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The upper triangle rotates 180º.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc169e341f32a97901778982d19b94dcc78f6610d525c28c6b671937a12141cc.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The lower triangle rotates 180º.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bf339bb593d9002b63161bd7281538e9fc3fd3e08f9959346a11e20c13f0153.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure:**

The upper triangle rotates 180º.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/081af09f75c749abeba442b93ca5077130827e8547614b286d6e3232e63ce75c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**
